description: Implementation of a thread-safe fixed size Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and scanning cache entries, including expiration handling and cluster event invalidation.

classes.name: LRU
classes.description: A thread-safe fixed size Least Recently Used cache with expiration and cluster invalidation support.

classes.name: entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with key, value, expiration time, and generation for cache versioning.

methods.name: NewLRU
methods.description: Creates a new LRU cache with specified options.

methods.name: Purge
methods.description: Clears the cache completely and increments the generation.

methods.name: SetWithDefaultExpiry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the cache with default expiration.

methods.name: SetWithExpiry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the cache with specified TTL.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes a value from the cache by key.

methods.name: GetMulti
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for given keys.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: RemoveMulti
methods.description: Removes multiple cache entries by keys.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Iterates over cache keys, passing them to a callback.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the cache.

methods.name: GetInvalidateClusterEvent
methods.description: Returns the cluster event associated with cache invalidation.
